commit.message: feat(workflow): add dopemux transition proof envelope to transition responses

pr.title: feat(workflow): add Dopemux transition proof envelope to advance_item / complete_tree responses
pr.body: Adds an additive `dopemux_proof_envelope` field to advance_item and complete_tree responses so the Dopemux consumer (dopemux-mvp / TP-DMX-ORCH-014B) can validate workflow-transition receipts. Schema version is '1'. The envelope is metadata-only; existing parsers continue to read existing fields unchanged. No workflow semantics change. See docs/dopemux-integration.md for the full envelope contract.

steps.task: Define data class DopemuxProofEnvelope with schema_version (= '1'), workflow_id, transition, idempotency_key, actor, canonical_writer (= 'task-orchestrator'), receipt { proof_id, operation, status }.
validation: Kotlin data class compiles and round-trips through Jackson/kotlinx.serialization without loss.
Schema fields exactly match dopemux-mvp's _validate_transition_proof_envelope() required set.
Receipt status enum mirrors the consumer's allowed receipt statuses.

steps.task: Modify AdvanceItemHandler to attach the envelope to its response.
validation: Existing AdvanceItemHandlerTest cases continue to pass without modification of non-envelope assertions.
New tests assert envelope presence + correctness for queue->work, work->review, review->terminal transitions.
Idempotency-key plumbing exists end-to-end (caller supplies key, response echoes the same key).
Existing CompleteTreeHandlerTest passes without non-envelope-assertion changes.
New tests assert envelope is present on partial and full completion responses.

steps.task: Snapshot the existing advance_item and complete_tree response JSON, then add the envelope and confirm the original fields are byte-for-byte unchanged.
validation: Snapshot diff shows only the additive envelope; no existing keys renamed, removed, or reordered.
Consumer-side: the dopemux-mvp existing transition-handling unit tests continue to pass against an envelope-bearing response (verified separately in TP-DMX-ORCH-014B follow-up).

steps.task: Regenerate the MCP tool schemas in artifacts/repo-truth-pack/MCP_TOOL_SCHEMAS/ for advance_item and complete_tree to include the new envelope field.
validation: Schema files validate as valid JSON Schema draft-07.
Schema diff reviewer-friendly (alphabetical keys, stable indentation).

steps.task: Write docs/dopemux-integration.md describing the envelope contract, the Dopemux consumer side, and the explicit note that this Kotlin server is NOT execution authority or proof authority — only a workflow-transition receipt.
validation: Doc compiles into the existing site without lint failures.
Doc links back to the dopemux-mvp TP-DMX-ORCH-014B consumer.
